name: Zero-start soft-force tangent Chord without attention VE
tagline: The six h-conditioned tangent Chord controls with the native attention VE tables and gates removed.
description: Retains zero initial velocity, the input smear and the complete update-based soft-force Chord block. Only attention value embeddings and their gates are removed.
mechanism: Update-based branch force with F / sqrt(mean(F²) + 0.05²)
Existing split position step and spherical retraction
Native-zero output projections and learned h-only read, position and velocity scales
limitations: A 16,000-update prefix of the 46,875-update reference schedule.
